summary: Implemented one deterministic fixture-only command that reads raw crypto numeric market fixtures, runs intake normalization, sends normalized supported markets through scorer -> review table -> paper order plan, and retains rejected raw markets with rejection reasons.
limitations: Fixture-only command; it does not fetch live markets, prices, APIs, or external metadata.
Generated paper order plan is an offline review artifact only and cannot place orders.
No runtime integration, dispatcher/run_codex, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, real orders, live trading, unrelated cleanup, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-010: add a concise offline demo review bundle that points reviewers to the intake-to-chain JSON and Markdown artifacts.
